name: Bases View Checkpoints
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
A restore no longer wraps long lines.
First release of Bases View Checkpoints.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
A restore no longer changes the line wrapping, list spacing or line ends of the other views in the file.
tip: Run "Undo last checkpoint restore" to put the file text back after a restore, if the file has not changed since.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases View Checkpoints is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
